blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A male American national wanted in the United States (US) for the alleged sexual abuse of a minor in Los Angeles, California, has been arrested in Pampanga, according to the Bureau of Immigration (BI). The BI apprehended the 50-year-old American fugitive during an enforcement operation at Camp Tomas Pepito in Angeles City, Pampanga, on Sept. 10, following a request for assistance from the U.S. Embassy in Manila.
